collection.title: Ford Ka 1996 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Ka 1996 - 2007 model requires a 19" wiper blade for the drivers and a 17" passengers side with a Standard Hook Arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Ka which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
